content.title: NCAA Women’s Basketball Tournament Highlights: South Carolina, Texas Advance to Final Four
content.text: Live Coverage for this has ended Mar 30, 2026 - 11:32p ET South Carolina Closes Out TCU South Carolina scored 29 points in the fourth quarter to pull away from TCU and advance to the Final Four. Joyce Edwards finished with 24 points and 12 rebounds to help the Gamecocks make their sixth straight Final Four. Mar 30, 2026 - 10:02p ET South Carolina Surging South Carolina knotted things up at the end of the first quarter, keeping things competitive heading into the second. The Gamecocks continued to battle, eventually taking the lead and carrying a 35-27 edge into halftime.Mar 30, 2026 - 9:59p ET TCU Gets Hot TCU went on a 6-0 run to get things started, making an early statement that the Horned Frogs were here to play.Mar 30, 2026 - 9:09p ET Longhorns Advance In the end, the Longhorns were too much for the Wolverines to overcome, and they cruised to a 77-41 victory.Mar 30, 2026 - 8:52p ET Texas Dominating Texas opened the fourth quarter by going on a 14-0 run to take a whopping 40-point lead, 69-29, with 5:56 to play.Mar 30, 2026 - 8:41p ET Michigan Not Giving Up Michigan was giving it all it had late in the game, but Texas wasn't letting up either. The Longhorns took a hefty 26-point lead into the fourth quarter, 55-29, but the Wolverines continued to give it 100%.Mar 30, 2026 - 8:28p ET Wolverines Putting In Work The Wolverines weren't going down without a fight, and that's exactly what they put up in the third quarter.Mar 30, 2026 - 7:59p ET Longhorns Rolling It was more of the same in the second quarter for Texas, which was a force to be reckoned with. The Longhorns were pulling out all the stops early, sinking one huge basket after another to keep Michigan at bay.Texas led 34-21 at halftime.Mar 30, 2026 - 7:38p ET Texas Jumps Out Ahead Texas went on a 10-0 run to start the game and jumped out to a 22-9 lead to end the first quarter. Longhorns star Madison Booker connected on her first three attempts, as Texas went 9-for-9 from the field to start the game.Mar 30, 2026 - 7:09p ET Texas-Michigan, South Carolina-TCU Previews Texas is favored by 10.5 points headed into Monday's tilt — and rightfully so. The Longhorns are a truly battle-tested team, having played 17 ranked teams during the regular season and in the Big 12 Tournament. Coach Vic Schaefer and the Longhorns went 14-3 in those games, including two wins over fellow championship hopeful team South Carolina. This will be the first meeting between Texas and Michigan this season. The Wolverines went 6-5 against ranked opponents in the regular season and in the Big Ten Tournament.South Carolina is favored by 13.5 points headed into Monday's matchup and is looking to continue its dominant reign; the Gamecocks have made the past five Final Fours, three of the last five championship games and have won the national title twice in the past five years. Can TCU pull off an upset? Nothing's impossible, but it will surely be an uphill battle for the Horned Frogs, who have won their three tournament games by a combined 59 points, while South Carolina has won its three games by a combined 135. Live Coverage for this began on Mar 30, 2026 - 11:57p ET
